# D3

D3 3.5.17 is vendored to preserve compatibility with the existing chart APIs and remove runtime CDN dependence.

Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/3.5.17/d3.min.js
Upstream: https://github.com/d3/d3/tree/v3.5.17
License: BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE.d3).

A migration to a newer major version requires updating scales, shape generators, event handlers, and data loaders together; do not replace this file alone.
